authority.owner_training_target: Qwen3.5-0.8B-class reusable cognitive-process substrate for variable-N cognitive grid + persistent DB + Claude Code bridge

observed_dissociation.semantic_readability: approximately 0.94-1.00 from about L6 onward on measured lexical family
observed_dissociation.strongest_supported_interpretation: semantic reading, symbol-axis writeout and carrier-space binding algebra exist at measured scope; the highest-value missing function is context-dependent semantic-slot -> episode-local codebook -> output-symbol routing/binding

swarm_roles.result: Created a two-stage binding curriculum: P0 isolates episode-local slot-to-symbol routing; P1 reattaches natural semantic decoding while holding the router task constant.
Required all 6 S3 mappings to be realized in the actual codebook, not merely stored as permutation metadata; target must be derived from realized mapping.
Required exact class-symbol balance and counterfactual groups in which fixed semantic content is paired with every S3 mapping.
Allowed ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN only inside the explicit episode-local codebook for integrated examples; semantic scenario text must not contain class words. P0 is label-free and uses K0/K1/K2 slots.
Retained at least four structurally different train templates because measured within-template decodability did not transfer reliably across templates.
For each fixed semantic case, changing only the episode codebook must change the target according to the new mapping; this makes codebook consultation causally necessary for success.

Do not retrain semantic recognition or symbol emission as the primary objective and do not promote a single static steering vector. Low-rank semantic subspace evidence is protected; positive J-Space labels remain forbidden without same-model causal receipts.

Closed S3-metadata-only, fixed codebook-order and gross class-symbol-frequency shortcuts in the new generator; identified unresolved tokenizer, unseen-symbol, unseen-template, lexical-family, query-polarity and representation-geometry gates.

A concurrent current-main donor added tools/trigger2_binding_router_blueprint_generator_v2.py at a66a030e. It contributes explicit TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT template scaffolding and ABI placeholder discipline. It is complementary, not independent evidence.

Future v3 should fuse the router-only isolation and deterministic counterfactual audits from generate_trigger2_dynamic_binding_seed_v2.py with the separate split/template scaffold from trigger2_binding_router_blueprint_generator_v2.py, without creating a third competing semantic authority.

useful_donor_mechanisms: four TRAIN templates plus separate VALIDATION and HOLDOUT templates
class labels confined to CODEBOOK model-input span
review_cautions: placeholder names contain TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT-style markers and therefore must never reach model training/evaluation unrendered
template identity and symbol-pool identity are currently coupled, so unseen-template and unseen-symbol effects are not independently identifiable
codebook class-entry order is fixed and should be randomized/counterbalanced
placeholder rendering does not by itself establish exact tokenizer count or single-token output status

curriculum.purpose: Install/test pure dynamic lookup independent of semantic parsing.
curriculum.input_abstraction: K0/K1/K2 internal semantic-slot token in model-visible training scaffold
curriculum.warning: This is a behavioral curriculum device, not evidence that K0/K1/K2 literally exist as model-internal coordinates.

curriculum.purpose: Compose already-readable natural semantics with the dynamic router across structurally distinct contexts.
curriculum.counterfactual_rule: same semantic case x all six S3 codebooks

curriculum.purpose: Add frozen unseen templates/symbols/lexical families, target x opaque-code x query-polarity factorialization, tokenizer-position matching, rank-aware geometry and nuisance/off-target controls before any promotion claim.

loss_hypothesis.behavioral_full_ft: next-token loss on opaque mapped symbol is the only currently evidence-safe positive training target
loss_hypothesis.counterfactual_structure: sample complete S3 counterfactual groups so memorizing a semantic-class-to-token prior is anti-correlated with success
loss_hypothesis.hidden_state_auxiliary_loss: HYPOTHESIS_ONLY; do not supervise internal J-Space/subspace targets until exact selected Qwen3.5 checkpoint has same-model causal receipts and a separately preregistered ABI

external_method_inputs.title: Symbol tuning improves in-context learning in language models
external_method_inputs.relevance: Replacing natural labels with arbitrary symbols pressures models to learn input-label mappings and improves flipped-label following; supports the opaque codebook curriculum as a method input, not as Clay-specific evidence.

external_method_inputs.title: Contextual Linear Activation Steering of Language Models
external_method_inputs.relevance: Context-dependent control can outperform fixed-strength steering; supports prioritizing dynamic context-conditioned routing over one static direction, without granting model-specific causal credit.

next_exact_action: Fuse the two current-main v2 donor generators into one successor generator that preserves P0 router isolation, randomized actual S3 mappings and exact counterbalance while adding independent TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT template and symbol-family axes plus query-polarity factorialization. Before rendering any training-eligible rows, ingest the exact accepted 46-atom ABI list and tokenizer identity; then freeze family-level splits and run deterministic leak/shortcut/tokenization gates.
